description: This source file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeManager's command extraction functionality within the OpenClaw project. It tests various scenarios of extracting commands following wake words in transcribed speech, using mock data and helper functions.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: A suite of tests verifying the behavior of command extraction logic in the VoiceWakeManager component.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that the command extraction returns nil if no trigger words are detected in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Tests that the command extraction correctly identifies and trims the command tokens following a trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Tests that the command extraction returns nil if the gap between trigger and command is less than the minimum required.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that the command extraction returns nil if no command words follow the trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Tests that empty or whitespace-only trigger entries are ignored in command extraction.
